name: Four/Four
description:
Most teams are sitting on a goldmine of customer insight they never actually use. It's scattered across sales calls, support tickets, emails, Slack chats, and survey responses, and by the time anyone gets around to reviewing it, the moment to act on it has usually passed. So instead, product roadmaps get built on internal opinion, sales pitches lean on assumptions, and customer success finds out about churn risk right around the time the customer cancels. Four/Four exists to fix that.

Four/Four is an AI-powered customer research co-pilot that connects to the tools teams already run on — Salesforce, HubSpot,, Zoom, Jira, Slack, Zendesk, Gong, and 30+ other integrations — and turns every call, ticket, and message into structured, usable intelligence. It automatically surfaces the pains, unmet needs, feature requests, and objections customers are raising, organised using frameworks teams already think in, like Jobs-to-be-Done, MEDDIC, and SPICED, and it links every insight back to the exact moment it was said so nobody has to take a summary on faith. Ask it a question in plain English and its AI Analyst will answer using real customer conversations as evidence, not guesswork. It clusters emerging themes automatically, tracks sentiment over time, and pushes findings straight into Slack, Jira, or email so the right people see them without having to go looking.

That makes it especially useful for the people who live inside customer conversations all day but rarely have time to synthesise them: product managers who need real evidence before committing engineering time to a feature, sales reps who want sharper account intelligence going into a call, marketers trying to get messaging right based on how customers actually describe their problems, and customer success teams trying to catch account risk before it becomes a lost renewal.

At its core, Four/Four is about closing the gap between what customers are telling you and what actually makes it into decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Four/Four to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Four/Four to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fourfour.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Four/Four MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four/Four provides these MCP tools: create_topic_model, find_accounts, find_contacts, find_conversations, find_insights, find_labels, find_topic_models, find_topics, and help.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Four/Four?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Four/Four in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Four/Four requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Four/Four is developed by Four/Four. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
